run_query_predictions_evaluation: run the PACO query prediction evaluation script with a predictions file and dataset
run_evaluation_with_pth_predictions: run the evaluation script using a PyTorch .pth predictions file for query predictions
run_evaluation_with_npy_predictions: run the evaluation script using a NumPy .npy predictions file for query predictions
run_ego4d_evaluation: run the evaluation script against the ego4d dataset using predictions containing ego4d in the filename
run_lvis_evaluation: run the evaluation script against the LVIS dataset using predictions without ego4d in the filename
